data.notes: Detroit’s June 2026 calendar leans heavily into hip-hop, R&B, jazz and riverfront festival programming, with Tec-Troit extending the city’s electronic-music identity beyond Movement weekend.

events.title: Don Toliver — Octane Tour with SahBabii, SoFaygo & CHASE B
events.summary: Don Toliver brings his arena-scale Octane Tour to Little Caesars Arena with SahBabii, SoFaygo and CHASE B listed as special guests.

events.title: Forrest Frank — The Jesus Generation Tour with Tori Kelly, Cory Asbury & The Figs
events.summary: Forrest Frank headlines Little Caesars Arena on The Jesus Generation Tour, joined by Tori Kelly, Cory Asbury and The Figs.

events.title: Boney James — Slow Burn Tour
events.summary: Saxophonist Boney James opens the June run of The Aretha Franklin Amphitheatre’s Jazzy Nights programming with his Slow Burn Tour date.

events.title: Maysa with Alex Bugnon
events.summary: Maysa appears at The Aretha Franklin Amphitheatre, with Alex Bugnon listed on the event lineup for this midweek jazz and soul concert.

events.title: Max Richter with American Contemporary Music Ensemble
events.venueName: Jack White Theatre at the Masonic Temple
events.summary: Composer Max Richter performs at the Jack White Theatre at the Masonic Temple with the American Contemporary Music Ensemble listed on the bill.

events.title: Hart of Detroit Summer Festival
events.summary: The Juneteenth-focused Hart of Detroit Summer Festival returns to Hart Plaza with advertised performances including Fetty Wap, Kash Doll and BabyTron.

events.title: The R&B Lovers Tour — Keith Sweat, Joe, Dru Hill, Ginuwine & Kut Klose
events.summary: Keith Sweat, Joe, Dru Hill, Ginuwine and Kut Klose bring The R&B Lovers Tour to the Fox Theatre for a major classic R&B package show.

events.title: Juvenile & The 400 Degree Band — The Desk Experience
events.summary: Juvenile brings The 400 Degree Band to The Aretha Franklin Amphitheatre, with Mannie Fresh and B.G. listed in the Ticketmaster lineup.

events.title: Lalah Hathaway with Eric Darius
events.summary: Lalah Hathaway plays The Aretha Franklin Amphitheatre as part of the venue’s Wednesday-night summer programming, with Eric Darius listed on the lineup.

events.title: Josh Groban with Jennifer Hudson
events.summary: Josh Groban’s North American arena tour stops at Little Caesars Arena with Jennifer Hudson as the featured special guest.

events.title: RSVP — Ray J, Sammie, Bobby V & Pleasure P
events.summary: R&B supergroup RSVP — Ray J, Sammie, Bobby V and Pleasure P — is scheduled for a Friday night concert at The Aretha Franklin Amphitheatre.

events.title: Tec-Troit Electronic Music Festival
events.summary: Tec-Troit is listed as a three-day free techno and house festival focused on Detroit-based musicians, with workshops and community programming alongside performances.
